employmentPath.heading: Roles and embedded leadership
employmentPath.description: For a staff role, long-term operating need, or referral, start with the resume or email Jamie directly.

scopedWork.heading: Scoped work
scopedWork.description: Begin at the level that fits the decision in front of you. Each option is separately scoped; none creates an automatic next engagement.

engagements.label: Focused working session
engagements.buyerQuestion: Is there one important decision, knot, or working artifact that would benefit from an hour of structured attention?
engagements.outcome: A clarified question, decision map, or agreed next step appropriate to the session.
engagements.boundary: This is paid, defined work. A separate agreement is required before the session begins or continues beyond its agreed scope.

engagements.label: Knowledge operations diagnostic
engagements.buyerQuestion: Does a specific workflow, evidence base, or team-memory problem need diagnosis before implementation?
engagements.outcome: A scoped map of what is known, open, protected, risky, and worth doing next.
engagements.boundary: The diagnostic is separately scoped. A separate agreement is required for any implementation that follows.

engagements.label: Implementation or fractional operations
engagements.buyerQuestion: Is there enough shared understanding to scope delivery, adoption, documentation, and handoff?
engagements.outcome: A separately agreed engagement with explicit scope, authority, cadence, and exit conditions.
engagements.boundary: A separate agreement is required for the engagement and for any extension or renewal.

supportingEntryCta.heading: Start with the decision in front of you
supportingEntryCta.description: Explore a focused working session, a knowledge operations diagnostic, or a separately scoped implementation engagement.
supportingEntryCta.label: See ways to work together

contactAction.label: Discuss a working session
contactAction.prompt: Share the decision, knot, or artifact involved; why it matters now; who needs to use the result; and any real deadline or access constraint.

termsNote: A conversation is not an engagement. Scope, timing, fees, and any paid work are confirmed in writing before work begins.
